newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Shara in Mideast talks with French envoy.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Shara in Mideast talks with French envoy.

text.p: Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara held talks in Damascus on Tuesday with a French envoy on the obstacles facing the Arab-Israeli peace process, officials said.
They said that Jean Claude Cousseran, director of the Middle East department at the French foreign ministry, also gave Shara a message from his French counterpart Herve de Charette.
They said that Cousseran, a former French ambassador to Syria, discussed with Shara issues related to bilateral cooperation.
Shara last week accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of putting the region on the verge of war by refusing to make peace with Damascus and building a settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
Syria strongly supports a French and a European role in the U.S-sponsored Middle East peace process.
Syria has held sporadic peace talks with Israel since 1991 but the negotiations have been blocked over the fate of the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in 1967 Middle East war.
Israel broke off negotiations with Syria in March last year after a series of suicide bombs in the Jewish state and no talks have been held since Netanyahu took office in June.
